html:
SMTO-CMP-0011 — This task has too many results for SMTO to check at once

GUID: 80d00918-99df-4bbb-a92b-4578c8826a48
Slug: completion-evidence-bundle-limit
Domain: CMP · Subsystem: cmp

What happened

  • To confirm a task is done, SMTO checks the results the AI points to, and it can check at most 32 groups at once. This task's proof went over that limit. Work already done is kept.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look at the task's steps to confirm which parts finished. That work is saved and doesn't need to run again. The problem is the size of the proof, not the work itself.
  2. If the task shows Partial · resumable, select Resume on the task. The AI can then finish by pointing to only the most important results, which fits within the limit.
  3. For future work this large, split it into several smaller tasks, for example one task per server or folder. Each smaller task has fewer results to check, so it stays under the limit.

What success looks like

  • The task shows Completed and its final reply appears under it.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Check whether the earlier action already happened before anything is repeated. Don't restart the whole task; it would repeat every finished step and hit the same limit.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Resolved completion evidence exceeded the 32-logical-group bundle limit, required caller-check evidence could not fit within that limit, or the safe recovery projection could not keep exact candidate IDs and revision (reason evidence_bundle_limit).

What this means

  • Resolved completion evidence exceeds 32 receipt IDs, required evidence cannot fit that bound, or safe recovery projection cannot preserve exact candidate identities/revision. Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.

Why this can happen

  • Resolved completion evidence exceeds 32 receipt IDs, required evidence cannot fit that bound, or safe recovery projection cannot preserve exact candidate identities/revision.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect expanded sequence children and safe projection size as well as top-level reference count.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the cited evidence and expanded sequence children in the rejected declaration (_verify_receipts and completion_evidence_candidates in src/agent_runtime/native/completion.py; start_recovery and RECOVERY_FACT_CHARS in native/recovery.py). Have the model cite only the relevant receipts or one shell sequence group per batch, and split work whose required checks span more than 32 groups into separate tasks.
  • Reduce the completion evidence bundle to the relevant authoritative receipt references.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect and reconcile authoritative state before repeating a mutation. Do not blindly retry.

How to verify the fix

  • A supported relevant bundle retains exact evidence identities and required coverage.

What not to do

  • Do not repeat a mutation while the earlier outcome or current owner is unresolved.

Technical notes

  • Completion checks consume retained evidence and the effective guard policy; they do not execute work. A rejected declaration preserves the answer and successful receipts, and only the original operation evidence establishes effects.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-EXE-0004 — Execution outcome is unknown
